{{Quote|Empire!|Presk|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Presk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was part of the escort that accompanied a Republic Senator and [[Darmas Pollaran]] to ''[[Port Nowhere]]'' alongside [[Kuthana]], [[Matto]], and [[Rowost]] when ''Port Nowhere'' got under attack by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
